title: Mar of Mashkhei
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Menachot 43a relates that he brought tekhelet, blue-dyed wool, in Rav Achai's time. Rashi explains that his name was Mar and he came from Mashkha; Kiddushin 72a likewise has the form Mushkhei.[^1][^2]

notes.text: מג./עב. give Menachot 43a/Kiddushin 72a by convention, without a fresh Rashi or Talmud check. בשני דרב אחאי means in the years/days of Rav Achai, not two sessions; full Rav crosses the source line break. Tekhelet is contextually glossed blue-dyed wool, not extra supplied words.

Mashkhei/Mashkha/Mushkhei preserve three source forms. Hyman attributes the name-Mar/place explanation to Rashi, without a modern location or identity binding. Full מר is preserved in heading and quoted explanation.
